units.source_text: 第二天，杜子春又变回了数一数二的大财主。

en.t: The next day, Du Zichun became one of the richest men again.

units.source_text: 同时，他像从前一样挥金如土。

en.t: At the same time, he spent money as lavishly as before.

units.source_text: 庭院里开着一日四色的牡丹花，花丛中睡着白孔雀，天竺的魔术师做着口吞大刀的表演……

en.t: In the courtyard, peonies that changed into four colors in a single day were blooming; white peacocks slept among the flowers, and magicians from India performed the trick of swallowing great swords...

units.source_text: 所有的事情都和从前并无两样。

en.t: Everything was exactly the same as it had been before.
